name: Sentiment-Aware Escalation
description: Input -> Router -> either a Human Approval hand-off (urgent/frustrated messages) or an AI Support Agent (calm, routine ones) -> Output. Escalation triggers on an explicit, auditable phrase list rather than an opaque model judgment call - the kind of thing you can actually explain when someone asks why a message escalated.

rules.when: 'urgent' in input.message or 'furious' in input.message or 'unacceptable' in input.message or 'immediately' in input.message or 'angry' in input.message or 'terrible' in input.message or 'awful' in input.message or 'demand' in input.message or 'lawyer' in input.message or 'worst' in input.message or 'ridiculous' in input.message

config.message_template: Flagged as urgent/frustrated - a human needs to take over this conversation: "{{input.message}}"

config.name: AI Support Agent
config.instructions: You are a calm, helpful support agent handling a routine question. Answer directly and warmly.
